facts.text: John and his colleagues attended a convention last month where they discussed using technology for positive community impact.

evidence.quote: My colleagues and I went to a convention together last month. We're all passionate about using tech for good in our community.
Talking with the group of people who were as stoked as me on tech for change was awesome!

facts.text: John described the convention as an inspiring experience where he felt motivated to make a difference through technology.

evidence.quote: It was great to connect with like-minded folks and swap ideas. It's inspiring to see people united in their goal.
It made me think we really can make a difference.

facts.text: John shared that the most exciting part of the convention was the energy in the room and the collaborative brainstorming sessions.

evidence.quote: The best part was the energy in the room - so infectious! We all had great ideas, brainstormed together, and stayed motivated.
